fluff.overview: The CCAF fields conventional infantry in larger numbers than its limited industrial base might suggest, drawing on the Confederation's deep tradition of citizens' militia service. Capellan soldiers learn to fight with fewer resources and less support than their counterparts in wealthier states, compensating with resourcefulness and ideological commitment. CCAF foot platoons anchor the Confederation's garrison network, holding worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, they depend on prepared positions and local knowledge to offset their lack of mobility. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile. Equipped with man-portable anti-aircraft weapons, these platoons provide ground formations with a dedicated air defense capability against low-flying VTOLs and conventional aircraft.
